model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different language models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and is logarithmic, ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸ with a tick label interval of 2⁰, 2¹, 2², 2³, 2⁴, 2⁵, 2⁶, 2⁷, and 2⁸. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” and is linear, ranging from 0.4 to 0.8 with a tick label interval of 0.2. There are four lines displayed. The first line, colored dark blue with circular markers, represents “Llama-3B,” starting at approximately 0.42 when the number of completions is 2⁰ and rising to approximately 0.79 when the number of completions is 2⁸. The second line, colored dark green with triangular markers, represents “Llama-3B + FT,” starting at approximately 0.40 when the number of completions is 2⁰ and rising to approximately 0.75 when the number of completions is 2⁸. The third line, colored light blue with circular markers, represents “Llama-1B,” starting at approximately 0.37 when the number of completions is 2⁰ and rising to approximately 0.70 when the number of completions is 2⁸. Finally, the fourth line, colored light green with triangular markers, represents “Llama-1B + FT,” starting at approximately 0.35 when the number of completions is 2⁰ and rising to approximately 0.68 when the number of completions is 2⁸.
